name: Right Bite
questions: Can you exclude quinoa and oats as well as gluten?
Is your soy sauce or tamari gluten-free?
Is there an extra charge for intolerance plans?
quinoa_oat_flags: Healthy meal plans often include quinoa bowls and overnight oats. Ask them to exclude quinoa and oats as well as gluten

safe_dishes.dish: Meal plan with gluten-free flagged as an intolerance
safe_dishes.note: Set in the app; their FAQ says to contact customer service for complex intolerances

summary: Right Bite's FAQ (current site) lets you flag gluten-free as an intolerance, and a Gulf News review says there is no extra charge for intolerances; there is no dedicated GF plan, so confirm what it covers.
